visual.summary: Tail path is shorter and clearer; reject facial deformation for pinched snout, radial wrinkles and uneven jaw.
retained: Tail no longer loops forward across the body; reduced rear/lateral sweep and terminal stem.
Native triangulation removes subdivision-boundary degenerate triangles without shifting the surface.
rejected: Downward segmented Pose produced a hook and folds; preserved and rolled back.
r02 face narrowing and lip edits produced pinching and uneven jaw thickness; restored to r01 in r03.
remaining: Head still lacks the broad wedge muzzle, clean mouth seam and deliberate jaw of the official references.
Tail terminal bend remains too abrupt and transitions to a very thin stem; flame is provisional solid geometry.
Wing membranes, hands, feet and limb anatomy remain unfinished.
Dense inherited topology is not deformation retopology; no UVs, authored PBR materials, rig, clips, attack effects or game integration.
visual.reviewMethod: Root inspected matched clay and face renders, actual Blender GUI screenshots, the reimported GLB three-quarter render, and 12 frames decoded from each actual comparison MP4. This is sampled video inspection, not real-time continuous playback.

authoring: Root-owned Blender GUI sculpt and native mesh transforms; MCP setup, selection, coordinate rollback, capture and export. No new image or mesh generation.
promotion: No game deployment, merge or push. Official input ancestry retained.

geometry.tailTest: 0 confirmed crossings; four positive-gap detector candidates (0.000015–0.000030). Shared-vertex foldovers and other body areas are outside this bounded test.
geometry.blenderReopen: Source/GLB counts, world bounds and finite coordinates match for all four meshes.
